description: This file defines the internal class GrainDirectoryResolver, which manages the resolution of grain directories based on grain types and names within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for resolving directories, handling default directories, and interacting with external resolvers.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryResolver
classes.description: Manages the resolution of grain directories based on grain types and names, supporting default and custom directory resolution strategies.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns the appropriate grain directory for a given grain type.

methods.name: IsUsingDefaultDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the specified grain type is using the default grain directory.

methods.name: GetGrainDirectoryPerType
methods.description: Internal method to get the grain directory associated with a specific grain type, falling back to default if none is found.

methods.name: TryGetNonDefaultGrainDirectory
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a non-default grain directory for a given grain type, using resolvers and properties.
